resources.string: Help
DNS or ad blocker may be blocking this source
The image host is resolving to a local/block address. Try temporarily disabling Private DNS, ad blocking, or VPN filtering, or allowlist the blocked host, then try again.
Possible DNS/ad-block block. Tap Help for steps.
Network problem
The host name could not be resolved. Check your connection, Private DNS, VPN, or DNS filter, then try again.
The page request failed at the network layer. Check your connection and try again. If only this source keeps failing, the website or its CDN may be having problems.
Network issue detected. Tap Help for checks.
The source or server may be having problems

The website or its CDN appears to have closed or rejected the connection. Try again later, open the source website in a browser, and make sure the plugin is up to date. If the same source also fails in another supported app, report it to the source/plugin maintainer.
Likely source/server-side. Tap Help for checks.
The plugin parser may need an update
This error points to the %1$s plugin while parsing %2$s. Update the plugin first. If it still fails, copy the error details and report it to the plugin maintainer.
Likely plugin/parser issue. Tap Help for reporting steps.
Possible Miyorare compatibility issue
This failure points to Miyorare\'s plugin compatibility or Reader path. Copy the error details and report it to Miyorare so the compatibility layer can be checked.
Possible Miyorare compatibility issue. Tap Help for reporting steps.
The cause is not clear yet

Miyorare cannot reliably tell whether this came from the network, source, plugin, or app. Try again, check the source in a browser, update the plugin if applicable, and copy the error details if you need to report it.
Cause not certain. Tap Help for checks.
